leadText: (Japanese: ポケモン３Ｄアドベンチャー　ミュウを探せ！ Pokémon 3D Adventure: Find Mew!) is the 14th Pikachu short of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired at 109 Cinemas Nagoya adjacent to the theme park from March 18 to September 25, 2005 as part of the 2005 Pikachu Project. It was screened again in 2017 and 2020 together with PK16 in Japanese theaters.
